articles.title: Katholisches Jubiläum: Papst Leo XIV. erklärt Heiliges Jahr für beendet
articles.teaser: Alle 25 Jahre feiern Katholiken ein Heiliges Jahr. Millionen von Gläubigen pilgern dann in den Vatikan, um ein Bronzeportal zu passieren. Nun ist das Kirchenjahr vorbei.
articles.image_title: Katholisches Jubiläum: TOPSHOT - Pope Leo XIV closes the Holy Door of St. Peter's Basilica on the Feast of the Epiphany, marking the official end of the Jubilee Year 2025, at the Vatican, on January 6, 2026. (Photo by Yara Nardi / POOL / AFP via Getty Images)

articles.title: Brand in der Silvesternacht: Keine Brandschutzkontrollen in Bar in Crans-Montana seit 2020
articles.teaser: In der abgebrannten Bar in der Schweiz hat es jahrelang keine Brandschutzkontrollen gegeben. In früheren Jahren war das Dämmmaterial an der Decke kein Thema gewesen.
articles.image_title: Brand in der Silvesternacht: Police officers control the entrance to the bar Le Constellation where a fire ripped through the venue during New Year's celebrations in the Alpine ski resort town of Crans-Montana killing around 40 people and injuring more than 100 others, in Crans-Montana on January 2, 2026. Investigators raced on January 2, 2026 to identify the victims of a fire that ripped through a bar in the Swiss Alps town of Crans-Montana, turning a New Year's celebration into one of the country's worst tragedies. Frederic Gisler, police commander in the Wallis canton in southwestern Switzerland, told reporters that authorities had counted "around 40 people who have died and around 115 injured, most of them seriously". (Photo by MAXIME SCHMID / AFP via Getty Images)

articles.title: Stromausfall Berlin: S-Bahnen in Berliner Südwesten fahren nach Stromausfall wieder
articles.teaser: Die Berliner Strombetriebe haben die Stromversorgung in drei betroffenen S-Bahnhöfen wiederhergestellt. Weiterhin sind 25.500 Menschen im Berliner Südwesten ohne Strom.
articles.image_title: Stromausfall Berlin: BERLIN, GERMANY - JANUARY 4: A police line at the entrance to the closed Mexicoplaz S-Bahn train station, during power outage, following an arson attack on power cables on January 4, 2026 in Berlin, Germany. The attack on the cables happened at a bridge crossing the Teltow Canal caused a blackout affecting approximately 45,000 residents as well as local businesses, hospitals and nursing homes in southwestern Berlin. The Stromnetz Berlin utility company has since restored power to approximately 7,000 residents but others will likely have to wait much longer to be reconnected . According to police, the perpetrators set fire to the cables early Saturday morning, the incident is similar to a previous attack on the city's electricity infrastructure in 2025. (Photo by Omer Messinger/Getty Images)
